item.subject: science
item.stem: Meena's school in Jaipur uses a solar water heater, a solar cooker in the midday meal kitchen, and solar panels on the roof. On a heavily cloudy day with no direct sunlight, which of these will stop working as usual because it needs heat or light from the Sun?

options.A: The solar water heater, because it heats water using electricity from the mains
options.B: All three devices, because each one depends directly on heat or light from the Sun
options.C: Only the solar cooker, because the water heater and panels store the Sun's heat for cloudy days
options.D: None of them, because solar devices work the same whether the Sun is visible or not
